reason: Pooled coefficient indicators in one generated dataset are correlated. Fixed-time Wilson intervals also do not justify repeated precision-based stopping. Retain their historical descriptive output, but do not use it for qualification.
independent_unit: One independently generated outer dataset, separately for each scenario and grid. Never count its 351 correlated coefficients or its 999 bootstrap draws as independent Monte Carlo replications.
coverage_estimand: Expected within-outer fraction of covered generating coefficients, equally weighted over outer datasets. With the fixed 351-coordinate denominator this preserves the pooled point estimand, not the former independence assumption. It does not establish coverage of every coordinate separately.
uncertainty_method: Two one-sided fixed-mixture betting processes inverted into a bounded-mean confidence sequence. For every m in (0,1), Lplus(m)=mean_f product_t(1-f+f*Z_t/m); Lminus(m)=mean_f product_t(1-f+f*(1-Z_t)/(1-m)). Retain m when both processes are below 2/alpha_per_sequence. Use conservative outside brackets for numerical inversion.
mixture_weights: equal; fixed before inspecting final Batch 1 numerical results; never tuned to achieve qualification
multiplicity: Union bound over 4 scenarios x 2 grids x 2 metrics. Each sequence splits its alpha equally between the two directions. Ville's inequality covers all examination times without assuming independence between scenarios, grids or metrics.
assumption: Within a fixed scenario/grid, successive generated outer datasets have the same conditional mean for each bounded metric. Do not condition on successful fits, omit failures, change the generating design midstream or replace failed outers.
failure_rule: All planned reports, both grids, all 999 draws and all 36 finite family tests must verify before a decision. At the unchanged maximum, unresolved precision or failed admission stops without qualification. A conservative interval is not a reason to loosen a threshold or extend the maximum.
missing_outer_reports_rule: Count-only historical aggregates cannot qualify or authorize a next batch. Restore the original outer reports, NPZ arrays and draw records first; no numerical rerun is required.
limitations: This simple finite mixture is not the optimized adaptive algorithm of the cited paper; no optimal-width claim is made.
Synthetic calibration advances only to realized-design validation. It does not authorize empirical ecology or establish measurement validity.
